objective: Extend the rig pipeline to every family of animals: an elephant's trunk and ears, an upright animal (the meerkats), a tortoise's rigid shell and sliding head, and a clip set each for the jackals, elephants, meerkats and tortoises.
acceptance_criteria: Landmarks are measured on points all over the surface, not on vertices: a big-faceted model (the base Elephant) measures as well as a dense one
The head end is told by volume beyond the feet, and a model made back to front is turned round
An elephant gets four trunk bones and two ear bones, found on the model; a clip poses them (trunk: curl and sway; an ear by name) and they follow through on springs
An upright animal is rigged with planted legs and arms that ride with its body, posed by where its hands go (autoland_up.py)
A tortoise's shell does not bend and its head slides into it; export_game.py writes a position for every bone that moves
Each of the seven families has its own clip set at the game's lengths, with a walk at the game's pace
verification: Blender 5.2, 2026-11-28. Worst stretch of any clip on each family's base model, rigged from measured landmarks: Jackal 5.3 %, Elephant 5.7 % (trunk and ears), Tortoise 4.5 %, Meerkat 12.3 % (arms thrown overhead from where they hang; its walk, idles and bite under 2 %). Six clips of each of the Elephant, the Meerkat and the Tortoise rendered and looked through on contact sheets: the trunk lifts and curls, the ears fan, the Meerkat stands, rakes and jumps, the Tortoise spins tucked on its shell and lands on its back. Found there and fixed: a topple's pivot is measured from the root, so the rhinos' topple (and two new ones) ended under the floor. Nine more models (Earth and Lava Rhino; base, Sun and Shadow Lion; base, Hurricane, Lightning and Thunder Cheetah) went through batch.sh untouched: every clip whole on its sheet, worst stretch 4 to 10 % except the Thunder Cheetah (15 %: the cloud puffs round its legs).
notes: Tools only. Not done: wings (the Sphinx), banners and manes on springs, ears on anything but an elephant; the Thunder Cheetah's clouds want to be rigid pieces; the Meerkat's shoulders stretch when its arms go overhead. The flamingos wait for SHANNON.
